Name: T's Big-Craftables Pack
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[size=4]
It takes too long to get lots of them! The concept of this mod is to allow you to use a crafting machine to convert items that you can't get a lot of!

All machines have animations for visual enjoyment.

We are trying to make adjustments so that the game is not extremely unbalanced... If you have any complaints, please let us know on the POSTS page.

All machines are locked to prevent the game from becoming too easy by opening them up from the beginning.[/size][size=4](*Material Converter* is the only one that has a much better performance because the release conditions are strict and the recipe is difficult to find.)[/size]

[size=4]Currently English and Japanese are supported.[/size]
